entry_state: Dated POCI receipts preserve the original credit-adjusted rate, signed allowance and separately supported write-offs. ACT/365F is supplied; fractional powers and non-rational rates require certified bounds, whose endpoints are not jointly selectable journals. A modification changes gross contractual PV before credit reassessment; recovery from impairment differs from reversal of SICR. Equal final equity can conceal different interest presentation. The collateral example uses a half-year1.1 factor, includes post-maturity receipts and has reached the final write-off finding at270; section11.9 continues.
exit_state: Collateral recovery ends at cash166.55 and equity−13.45 while the unpaid legal claim remains. Revolving capacity, funded allowance and undrawn provision evolve separately; fee purpose determines yield or service revenue. Transfer needs eligible-part and risk/reward/control findings. Guarantee, call, put and collar retain different asset/liability exposures; amortised-cost transfer uses separate interest schedules. A funding request creates no cash: confirmed receipts8,6,0 yield unpaid deposits2,4,10 with equity20 in each case. The funding subsection continues after276.

findings.observation: Revolving draw and repayment preserve credit history. The part-sale counterexample distinguishes relative fair value from principal proportion, and a retained-risk receipt is borrowing rather than a sale.
Call, written-put and collar relations are motivated by retained rights before numerical paths. Asset/liability differences represent the options, preventing duplicate option recognition.
The funding table compares independently evidenced receipts rather than assuming requested cash arrived. Unpaid deposits remain within the liability and are not added twice.
